title: Louis CK - Everything Is Amazing and Nobody Is Happy
summary: A short clip of Louis CK on Conan riffing that everything is amazing and nobody is happy, about complaining over modern wonders like air travel and wifi. The uploader added a note about the comedian's later misconduct.
why: HN commenters bring it up as a reminder to appreciate technology instead of complaining, from Waymo to AI art to flight delays.

quote.text: I like to watch this Louis CK clip, it really puts me back in place...for a while.
